name: freetier_public_games_serving
_sidecar_rationale: Documents JUST the games-static-serving additions (Caddy /play/* blocks + sync-games-build.sh + README_games.md). Kept separate from freetier_public_deploy.active.json to avoid edit-collision with parallel agents touching the deploy card.
summary: Adds Facebook Instant Games-compliant static hosting of Godot Web HTML5 builds at https://trollz.fun/play/<game_slug>/ and https://GentlyOS.io/play/<game_slug>/. The Caddyfile fragment grows two new (games_headers) and (games_mime) snippets plus a handle_path /play/* block inside EACH of the trollz.fun and GentlyOS.io server blocks (BEFORE their catch-all). The sync-games-build.sh script ships a freshly-exported Godot build from studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/ to /opt/mspc-public/games/<game_slug>/ via rsync+ssh, DRY_RUN=1 by default. README_games.md documents the build -> dry-run -> push -> rollback flow.
engine_pattern: Caddy file_server serves /opt/mspc-public/games/<game_slug>/index.html with COEP=require-corp + COOP=same-origin (needed for Godot 4 threaded WASM SharedArrayBuffer), CORP=cross-origin + CSP frame-ancestors allowing facebook.com / messenger.com (so FB can iframe the game). MIME overrides force application/wasm on *.wasm, application/octet-stream on *.pck / *.data. sync-games-build.sh is a standalone script (NOT chained into deploy.sh) — it runs pre-flight (slug regex, build dir + index.html present, rsync local, droplet SSH probe) and only rsyncs static files; never touches systemd or Caddy.

components.Caddyfile.droplet (additions): Two shared snippets at top: (games_headers) sets COEP/COOP/CORP/CSP/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy/Cache-Control; (games_mime) maps *.wasm to application/wasm and *.pck / *.data to application/octet-stream. Inside each domain block (trollz.fun, GentlyOS.io), a new `handle_path /play/* { root * /opt/mspc-public/games; import games_headers; import games_mime; file_server { index index.html } }` placed BEFORE the catch-all. Existing /terms*, /endpoint/freetier/*, /v1/*, /healthz blocks untouched.
components.sync-games-build.sh: Bash, set -euo pipefail. Args: game_slug (default 'myspace_pp'), local_build_dir (default '/data/Projects/MySpace++/studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games'). Env: DROPLET_HOST, REMOTE_GAMES_ROOT, SSH_KEY, DRY_RUN (default 1). Pre-flight: validates slug ^[a-z0-9_-]+$, verifies BUILD_DIR exists + has index.html, rsync installed locally, SSH BatchMode probe to droplet. Then mkdir + chown on droplet, rsync --delete-after with chmod=Du=rwx,Dgo=rx,Fu=rw,Fgo=r, post-rsync chown -R mspc:mspc + find chmod 755/644.
components.README_games.md: Operator docs: cc godot-export web_instant_games to build; bash sync-games-build.sh <slug> to dry-run; DRY_RUN=0 ... to push; FB Instant Games header rationale table; manual rollback via mv /opt/mspc-public/games/<slug>{,.broken}; explicit note that the script does NOT touch systemd / Caddy / FB registration.

headers_applied.Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp  — needed for SharedArrayBuffer (Godot 4 threaded WASM)
headers_applied.Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin   — pair with COEP for cross-origin isolation
headers_applied.Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin  — lets Facebook fetch our assets from inside its iframe
headers_applied.Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://www.facebook.com https://*.facebook.com https://www.messenger.com — whitelists FB / Messenger as embedders
headers_applied.Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 (short — exact-hash filenames are safer for long caching)

user_prerequisites_before_first_push: freetier_public_deploy has already run at least once with DRY_RUN=0 so the mspc user, /opt/mspc-public/ tree, and Caddy are in place
The updated Caddyfile.droplet has been shipped (re-run deploy.sh OR manually scp + caddy reload — see README_games.md)
Godot project exports a Web preset named 'web_instant_games' that writes to studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/
cc godot-export web_instant_games has produced an index.html + *.wasm + *.pck in the build dir
Same DNS + SSH key prereqs as freetier_public_deploy (A records, root@159.89.181.146 reachable)
substrate: studio/deploy/freetier_public/ — adds 3 deltas (Caddyfile additions + sync-games-build.sh + README_games.md) on top of the existing 5-file bundle owned by freetier_public_deploy.

inbound_callers: Tom runs sync-games-build.sh manually from laptop after exporting a Godot Web build
Public HTTPS clients hit https://trollz.fun/play/<slug>/ or https://GentlyOS.io/play/<slug>/
Facebook Instant Games iframe embeds https://www.facebook.com/instantgames/ -> https://trollz.fun/play/<slug>/
outbound_calls: ssh mkdir + chown on droplet (only when DRY_RUN=0)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: none locally; on droplet writes /opt/mspc-public/games/<game_slug>/ tree

guarantees: DRY_RUN=1 by default — accidental invocation never modifies droplet state
Pre-flight fails fast before any SSH call if build dir or index.html missing, or slug shape invalid
Slug regex ^[a-z0-9_-]+$ prevents path traversal into REMOTE_GAMES_ROOT
Existing freetier surfaces (/terms*, /endpoint/freetier/*, /v1/*, /healthz) untouched — only NEW handle_path /play/* blocks added
Does NOT modify deploy.sh or any systemd unit — separation of concerns from freetier_public_deploy
Does NOT register the game with Facebook — that is facebook_games_sdk's role (register_instant_game tool)
Does NOT call cc godot-export — Tom runs that explicitly before invoking this script
Idempotent — re-running upgrades in place via rsync --delete-after
usage_example:
cd studio/deploy/freetier_public/
# Build:
cc godot-export web_instant_games
# Dry-run sync:
bash sync-games-build.sh myspace_pp
# Real push:
DRY_RUN=0 bash sync-games-build.sh myspace_pp
# Verify:
curl -I https://trollz.fun/play/myspace_pp/
curl -I https://GentlyOS.io/play/myspace_pp/  # both expect COEP / COOP / CSP headers
rollback: ssh root@159.89.181.146 'mv /opt/mspc-public/games/<slug>{,.broken}' — Caddy will start 404ing /play/<slug>/ immediately (file_server). Re-push a known-good build with DRY_RUN=0 bash sync-games-build.sh <slug> /path/to/good/build. To take the games surface fully offline, comment the handle_path /play/* blocks in Caddyfile.droplet and reload caddy — other freetier routes keep serving.
phase: production hand-off bundle for Godot Instant Games static surface — sidecar of freetier_public_deploy (D.7+)
